properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the research's polygon « hv32-cote-divoire » (Cercles de Tenkodogo, Kaya, Ouagadougou, Koudougou, Gaoua, Batié, Bobo-Dioulasso et Dédougou rive droite : le reste du territoire), kept inside the Natural Earth polygon of Burkina Faso so its outer edge is the country's; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped.
